versions.content: Traffic Limitation IdsM shall drop an QSEv from transmission, if its transmission would cause the number of bytes transmitted in the current in- terval (specified in IdsMTrafficLimitationTimeInterval ), to exceed the max- imum number of bytes, configured in IdsMTrafficLimitationMaximumBytes .

Traffic Limitation IdsM shall drop an QSEv from transmission, if its transmission would cause the number of bytes transmitted in the current in- terval (specified in IdsMTrafficLimitationTimeInterval ), to exceed the max- imum number of bytes, configured in IdsMTrafficLimitationMaximumBytes .

Traffic Limitation IdsM shall drop an QSEv from transmis- sion, if its transmission would cause the number of bytes transmitted in the current interval (specified in IdsMTrafficLimitationTimeInterval ), to exceed the max- imum number of bytes, configured in IdsMTrafficLimitationMaximumBytes .
